_doc: Log of analysis METHOD changes (how information is gathered, what is written). Every change, even a small one, adds an entry; the highest version is ANALYSIS_VERSION. A page made with an older version shows the later entries and a targeted request to paste to Claude. 'title' is shown on the pages, one entry per language. 'auto': true = fixed by rerunning the listed scripts, no text to rewrite. 'todo' = what Claude must do on an existing page, and only that.

changes.todo: Write the intro and the summary of each build.

title.en: How to play / how to counter

changes.todo: Run the listed scripts on the folder, then write tldr and plan (early, mid, late, tips, role, abilities 1-4, strengths, weaknesses, vs).

Read the "L'avis des créateurs" section of the counter view (data/videos.json). If a video tip is missing from plan.vs or contradicts an existing point, add a point to plan.vs (or fix the contradicted one), citing it (source video:<id>@<s>) and saying whether the stats confirm it. Touch nothing else.

Add "sources" to summaries.json: for every text path (intro, <build>.resume, <build>.points[i], tldr.*, plan.*), the list of its sources (build:<key>, guide:<n>, video:<id>@<s>, stat:<module>, roles-guide, analyse). Do not rewrite the texts.

Run report.py and fix every "Shortened name" it reports (always the full official name, otherwise no link and no English translation). Reread the texts: every item or ability inside a sentence with a verb ("achète X", "X empêche…"), no telegraphic "… : Name."; the sentence must stay correct when the name switches to English.
Run report.py: ability upgrade texts now keep each effect separate (" · ") so the power-spike timeline shows one chip per effect. No text to rewrite.

title.fr: Objets clés dans les pics de puissance

changes.todo: Run report.py: power spikes now include the reference OTP's key items (>= 75% of games from 1,600 souls, >= 60% from 3,200 souls) at their real purchase minute, next to the ability order. No text to rewrite.

Write summaries.en.json: every text of summaries.json in English, same paths (finish.py "en": {...}), with official English item and ability names. Run apply.py --lang en on every build (automatic for English originals and generated OTP texts; non-English builds need "tr_en"). Add the English text of the hero's creator tips (videos.py add with "en").

title.fr: Où jouer et quoi faire, guides vidéo
title.en: Where to play and what to do, video guides

changes.todo: Write plan.lane (which lane or position on the map, and why). Rewrite tldr.early/mid/late/keys and plan.early/mid/late so they first say what to DO (where to stand, how to trade in lane, when to join fights, which objectives and timers), items second. If a creator guide video about the hero exists (videos.py list shows "guide"; find one on YouTube when the user mentions it), run videos.py fetch, then videos.py guide <id> <hero> <recommended build_id>@<mm:ss>, then find.py <hero> <folder> --videos-only, and use the transcript in these texts with video:<id>@<s> sources; summarise the added vid-<id> build (resume, points) and say where the video and the stats disagree. Same changes in English.

title.fr: Style de jeu par phase pour chaque build
title.en: Play style by phase for every build

changes.todo: Run playstyle.py, then report.py: every build whose author has >= 10 games on the hero gets its measured lean per phase (lane farm, jungle farm, fights, objectives, or balanced, vs the Phantom+ average), shown in the TLDR, the build view and the comparison. No text to rewrite.

title.fr: Objets clés mesurés même pour un build écrit
title.en: Measured key items even for a written build

changes.todo: Run report.py: when the advised build has no measured purchases (Mobalytics, community or video build), key items and item power spikes come from the best-ranked one-trick's real purchases, and the page says whose items and whose ability order it shows. No text to rewrite.

title.fr: Pas de généralités ni de redites

changes.todo: Run report.py and fix every "Filler" and "Repeated idea" it prints, in both languages. Reread intro, tldr and plan: remove game basics and meta phrases, and make sure no vs point restates a weakness (a weakness = the flaw + how the hero's player makes up for it; a vs point = something concrete for the opponent). Touch nothing else.

title.fr: Qui gagne la lane contre le héros
title.en: Who wins the lane against the hero

changes.todo: Run laning.py, then report.py: the counter view shows which heroes win or lose the lane against the hero (soul lead at 9 min, Phantom+ duo lanes) and the lane items (bought before 9 min) that win clearly more against it. No text to rewrite; plan.lane may cite it (source stat:laning).
